Hi Ishana,

Hope you are doing well.

I am Jahidul Islam, founder of Gift Ghor. I have been following your TikTok content and really love your aesthetic and video style.

Jahidul Islam

messages.body:
To: fatinakhyerishmam@gmail.com
Subject: Paid Partnership & PR Collaboration | Gift Ghor x Ishana

Dear Ishana,

I hope this message finds you well.

My name is Md Jahidul Islam Mozumder, founder of Gift Ghor (giftghorbd.com). I have been following your journey and creative storytelling on TikTok, and our team genuinely admires your distinctive aesthetic, authentic presence, and engaging presentation style.

At Gift Ghor, we curate premium lifestyle essentials, specializing in modern leather bags and smart, functional wallets. Your personal style and content direction align seamlessly with our brand philosophy, making you a natural fit for our upcoming seasonal showcase.

We would love to collaborate on a sponsored PR campaign featuring:
- A Curated PR Package: Handpicked, best-selling pieces from our latest collection tailored to your taste.
- Sponsored Deliverables: A dedicated TikTok showcase / styling feature that seamlessly introduces our products to your community.

If you are open to creative partnerships, please share your updated media kit, rate card, and standard collaboration terms with us.

Feel free to explore our aesthetic and current collection here:
- Website: https://giftghorbd.com
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/share/18bE4atTo8/?mibextid=wwXIfr

We would be delighted to work with you and look forward to hearing your thoughts.

Warm regards,

Md Jahidul Islam Mozumder
Founder, Gift Ghor
Website: giftghorbd.com
